steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Whose puppy are you? Why are you here?

steps.speaker: Puppy
steps.content: Whimper whimper...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: You still have a collar... You must have an owner, right? Where's your owner?

steps.speaker: Puppy
steps.content: Whimper...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I see... they left you here.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Would you like to come with me?

steps.speaker: Puppy
steps.content: Woof!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: You understand everything! What a smart puppy...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Look at you, all skin and bones... I'll call you Bone, okay?

steps.speaker: Bone
steps.content: Woof, woof!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I don't know your real birthday, so can we make today, the day I found you, your birthday?

steps.speaker: Bone
steps.content: Woof, woof, woof!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Good. Let's have Maresa take you for a bath first, then get Polly to make you some beautiful new clothes.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: From now on, Bone is a clean and healthy puppy, a member of the toy factory... and a member of our family.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Let Bass find you something delicious, and Benna can take you for a walk, okay?

steps.speaker: Bone
steps.content: Woof...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Why are you unhappy again?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Me? I can't take you for a walk...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: As you can see, I need a wheelchair to move.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: You want wheels, too? So that we can go together?

steps.speaker: Bone
steps.content: Woof!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Silly, I'm just teasing you. What's so good about wheels? I'm the one who envies you...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I've tried many times, but still can't stand up. I've caused a lot of trouble for my parents...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Bone...

steps.speaker: Bone
steps.content: Purr?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I... I want to take you for a walk, too. I want... to try standing up again.

steps.speaker: Bone
steps.content: Woof! Woof, woof! Woof, woof, woof, woof, woof, woof!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Hahaha, all right, all right. So much drool.
